title: Employee field permissions
description: For each detail of an employee, choose who may change it: the employee themselves, HR, or only the platform administrator. A change takes effect as soon as it is saved.
selfLocked: Can never be switched on for the employee

employee-fields.title: Employee field permissions
employee-fields.body: For each detail of an employee choose who may change it: the employee or HR. Identity, contract and pay fields can never be switched on for the employee. What you save takes effect at once.

can.edit: Change who may edit each field
can.export: Export the list to a file
